name: Dropbox
summary: Find, read, upload, organize, version and share Dropbox files through Composio OAuth2.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
preferences.title: Composio API key
preferences.description: Your Composio project API key. Save it here; never paste Dropbox tokens. Reload after saving.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_CONNECTED_ACCOUNT_ID
preferences.title: Dropbox connected account ID
preferences.description: Required: the actual active Dropbox OAuth2 connection ID from Composio (normally ca_...). This is not a project ID, playground test ID, or user ID. The owner is retrieved automatically.

tools.name: list_files
tools.title: List files in folder
tools.description: List files in folder via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to browse a Dropbox folder. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read. The card already shows the returned items. Keep default narration brief and do not repeat the entire list unless the user explicitly asks for those details.

tools.name: search_files
tools.title: Search files and folders
tools.description: Search files and folders via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to find Dropbox files or folders by keyword. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read. The card already shows the returned items. Keep default narration brief and do not repeat the entire list unless the user explicitly asks for those details.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.title: Get file or folder metadata
tools.description: Get file or folder metadata via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to inspect Dropbox file or folder metadata. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read.

tools.name: read_file
tools.title: Read a file
tools.description: Read a file via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to read a Dropbox file; Word .docx files up to 20 MiB return extracted readable text, while other binary formats return a file reference. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.title: Upload File
tools.description: Upload File via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to upload an existing local file to Dropbox; overwrite requires explicit approval. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read.

file.description: Full existing local file path, without surrounding quotes or brackets. Supports binary Word/PDF/image files up to 50 MiB; never invent a file reference.

children.text: Add stops if the destination exists. Overwrite replaces its contents. Enter add or overwrite.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.title: Create folder
tools.description: Create folder via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to create a Dropbox folder. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read.

children.text: Review the destination path, then create this folder.

tools.name: copy_item
tools.title: Copy file or folder
tools.description: Copy file or folder via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to copy a Dropbox file or folder to an exact destination. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read.

children.text: Review the exact source and destination before continuing.

tools.name: move_item
tools.title: Move file or folder
tools.description: Move file or folder via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to move or rename a Dropbox file or folder. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read.

children.text: Review the exact source and destination before continuing.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.title: Delete file or folder
tools.description: Delete file or folder via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to delete a Dropbox file or folder; recovery depends on the account plan. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read.

children.text: Deletes this item and everything inside it. Recovery depends on your Dropbox plan.

tools.name: list_revisions
tools.title: List file revisions
tools.description: List file revisions via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to inspect previous versions before restoring a Dropbox file. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read. The card already shows the returned items. Keep default narration brief and do not repeat the entire list unless the user explicitly asks for those details.

tools.name: restore_revision
tools.title: Restore file to specific revision
tools.description: Restore file to specific revision via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to restore a Dropbox file to the exact revision the user selected. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read.

children.text: Replaces the current file with the exact revision below.

tools.name: create_shared_link
tools.title: Create shared link
tools.description: Create shared link via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to create a shared link after approving the access change. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read. Shared links are already available through the card Open/Copy controls. Use the returned summary for a brief reply; do not rebuild the URL or print it in a second formatted response. Reuse the exact returned URL for revocation. Never repeat a completed write because narration formatting failed.

children.text: Creates a link using the default access settings for your Dropbox account.

tools.name: list_shared_links
tools.title: List shared links
tools.description: List shared links via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to inspect existing Dropbox shared links. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read. Shared links are already available through the card Open/Copy controls. Use the returned summary for a brief reply; do not rebuild the URL or print it in a second formatted response. Reuse the exact returned URL for revocation. Never repeat a completed write because narration formatting failed.

tools.name: revoke_shared_link
tools.title: Revoke shared link
tools.description: Revoke shared link via Composio OAuth2. Use when the user asks to revoke the exact Dropbox shared link selected by the user. Returns provider data including pagination; never infer all pages were read.

children.text: People using this link will lose access through it.

blocks.text: From this integration folder, run npm run setup to open the local Composio OAuth2 Connect/Disconnect page. After authorizing Dropbox, select Check connection and copy the active connected account ID (normally ca_...) into the field below with your Composio API key. Save both fields, then Reload. No separate User ID is required. You can also connect in the Composio dashboard. A pg-test-... playground identifier is not a connected account ID. To disconnect, use the setup page or remove the connection in Composio, then clear these preferences.
